# Plasma physics and fusion

Open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. Paths are relative to this folder; the index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| Id | Card | Applies when |
|---|---|---|
| CL-ALTERNATIVE-FUSION | [Claims for alternative fusion concepts](alternative-fusion.md) | the paper claims fusion yield, thermonuclear conditions, confinement, breakeven or a route to energy gain for a pinch, field-reversed configuration, spheromak, magnetized target, inertial electrostatic, beam-target, aneutronic-fuel or other concept outside mainstream tokamaks and laser-driven inertial fusion |
| CL-MAGNETIC-CONFINEMENT | [Claims of fusion performance in magnetic confinement](magnetic-confinement.md) | the paper reports fusion gain, fusion power or neutron yield, a fusion triple product, an energy confinement time or a confinement enhancement factor for a tokamak, stellarator or other magnetic-confinement device, or claims a record, breakeven or progress toward ignition |
| CL-INERTIAL-FUSION | [Claims of inertial-fusion yield and gain](inertial-fusion.md) | the paper claims a fusion yield, ignition, a burning plasma, breakeven or energy gain from a laser-driven or pulsed-power inertial-confinement (ICF) or magneto-inertial implosion, or infers such an experiment's ion temperature, hot-spot conditions or alpha heating from fusion products |
| T-DUSTY-PLASMAS | [Dusty and complex plasmas](dusty-plasmas.md) | the paper reports experiments with charged microparticles in a plasma, infers particle charge, mass or forces such as ion drag and thermophoresis from particle motion, tracks particles in video images, or claims crystalline order, melting or waves in a dusty or complex plasma |
| T-PLASMA-INTERFEROMETRY | [Interferometry and reflectometry](plasma-interferometry.md) | the paper measures plasma electron density or its fluctuations with microwave, far-infrared or laser interferometry, Faraday or Cotton-Mouton polarimetry, or profile, fluctuation or Doppler reflectometry, or bases a claim on density profiles, line densities or turbulence data from them |
| T-LANGMUIR-PROBES | [Langmuir probes](langmuir-probes.md) | the paper reports electron temperature, plasma density, plasma or floating potential, or an electron energy distribution measured with a single, double or emissive electrostatic probe, or bases a claim on a probe current-voltage characteristic |
| T-LASER-PLASMA-ACCELERATION | [Laser-plasma acceleration](laser-plasma-acceleration.md) | the paper reports electrons accelerated by a laser- or beam-driven plasma wakefield, or ions accelerated by an intense laser, and bases a claim about energy, energy spread, charge, divergence, emittance or stability on spectrometer, scintillator, image plate or track detector data |
| T-LOW-TEMPERATURE-PLASMAS | [Low-temperature and processing plasmas](low-temperature-plasmas.md) | the paper bases a claim on a radio-frequency, microwave, dielectric barrier, corona or pulsed discharge, a plasma jet or an electric thruster, for materials processing, plasma medicine, plasma-treated liquids, gas conversion or propulsion, or attributes an effect to plasma species |
| T-MAGNETIC-DIAGNOSTICS | [Magnetic diagnostics and equilibrium reconstruction](magnetic-diagnostics.md) | the paper uses magnetic probes, flux loops, Rogowski coils, saddle or diamagnetic loops, motional Stark effect data or an equilibrium reconstruction to report plasma current, position, shape, stored energy, safety factor or current profile, or bases a claim on a reconstructed magnetic geometry |
| T-FUSION-PRODUCT-DIAGNOSTICS | [Neutron and fusion-product diagnostics](fusion-product-diagnostics.md) | the paper reports fusion neutron yield, neutron spectra, neutron time-of-flight, neutron images, activation, or charged-particle or gamma-ray fusion-product data, or infers ion temperature, areal density, fusion power or a thermonuclear origin from them |
| T-SPACE-PLASMAS | [Space plasmas measured in situ](space-plasmas.md) | the paper bases a claim on particle distributions, plasma moments, or magnetic or electric fields measured on board one or several spacecraft, including boundary orientations and speeds, current densities, wave properties, or statistics of events drawn from mission data |
| T-PLASMA-SPECTROSCOPY | [Spectroscopic plasma diagnostics](plasma-spectroscopy.md) | the paper infers electron or ion temperature, electron density, flow velocity or impurity content of a plasma from emission, absorption or charge-exchange spectra, using line intensities or ratios, line widths, Doppler shifts, Stark broadening or collisional-radiative modelling |
| T-THOMSON-SCATTERING | [Thomson scattering](thomson-scattering.md) | the paper infers electron temperature or density, ion temperature, charge state, flow or an electron distribution from laser light scattered by free electrons in a plasma, by incoherent (non-collective) or collective Thomson scattering, or bases a claim about plasma conditions on such spectra |
| T-PLASMA-TURBULENCE | [Turbulence and transport in plasmas](plasma-turbulence.md) | the paper measures plasma density, temperature or potential fluctuations, their spectra, correlation lengths or cross-phases, infers a turbulent flux or diffusivity from fluctuations or power balance, or compares measured turbulence or transport with gyrokinetic or fluid simulations |
